CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2772 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 94da32128301b896241a0d38d8c8904b7181b199. Bus nonce: e76120c1f46eb4ce430ae27671fbf7be. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 94da32128301b896241a0d38d8c8904b7181b199`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 94da32128301b896241a0d38d8c8904b7181b199` or `Fix review: blocked 94da32128301b896241a0d38d8c8904b7181b199 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: e76120c1f46eb4ce430ae27671fbf7be`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `94da32128301b896241a0d38d8c8904b7181b199` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2772 94da32128301b896241a0d38d8c8904b7181b199") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2772-e76120c1`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Review #2772 (R10-TRAIN-UPGRADE, critical priority, owner-ordered) at its live head under fix-review.md, from a detached worktree, with the finder's harness. Run dev/audit/harnesses/r10_train_upgrade_mutants.py (28 runs: M0 passes and the 27 mutants are killed), tools/audit/seat/merge_train.py --self-test and tools/audit/seat/train.sh --self-test, and the race test (two concurrent adds give one train and one spooled entry). Check the Train.policy_approve guard: it posts only with exactly one in-force mandate, no owner approval yet, and no *_budgets.json in the diff; try a mutant for each of the three conditions and a null control where all hold. Check Forward-carry to R10-FLOW-AUTOTRAIN (Roster SHA 4937d60fe on handoff/audit-r10-roster) is routed and the claim files are untouched.
No host or home paths in anything you push; cite repo-relative paths only (app_comment.sh refuses an account name).
Round 2: the previous head had tests / fast (3.14) red because dev/audit/harnesses/r10_train_upgrade_mutants.py hand-walked the repo root (tests/harness_headers.py "depth seams" refusal) and the body's ## Red checks did not name it. Confirm the harness now uses the canonical helper, tests/harness_headers.py passes, the mutants harness still gives 28 runs (M0 passes, 27 killed) with the new root, and the body answers every red including the root-cause trigger (defect-root-cause.md).
